items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: Well that was Rene, Zeb, Morris French. The band you play was...

ctx.x: I could run up there with Punch sometime. I wonder if he ever worked with Punch. That would be fun.
He'd go up there and Morris would give you the whole lowdown on this time. That's right.
Did you play with him in the old days?
